  PROBLEM: The workflow gate skips closed PRs, so the merged-PR recovery flow never reaches `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` for standalone reruns.
  WHY: The gate sets `SHOULD_RUN="false"`/`SKIP_REASON="pr_closed"` for merged PRs, so `PR_ALREADY_MERGED`/`merge_with_followup` is dead code outside the orchestrator path.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:526-549 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The merged-PR action guard exits 0 without emitting structured outputs for the refusal.
  WHY: Reviewers reported missing `judge_skip_reason`, and one also reported missing `judge_handled`/`judge_action`, leaving downstream logs unable to classify the refusal.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:522-545 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The judge comment is posted before the merged-PR action guard runs.
  WHY: A merged PR can receive a comment claiming `fix`/`close_and_reissue` even when the guard later refuses and exits.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:799 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `grep -xE 'open|closed|merged'` allows a `merged` PR state that GitHub's REST API never returns.
  WHY: GitHub reports merged PRs as `state=closed` with `.merged=true`, so the extra `merged` alternative is dead code and misleading.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10130 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The same `.state` filter accepts `merged` even though the REST API only returns `open` or `closed`.
  WHY: This mirrors the dead-code pattern in `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:799` and can mislead maintainers.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10169-10172 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The orchestrator wraps `gh pr merge --squash` in `gh_retry` while the standalone path intentionally does not.
  WHY: On non-transient failures like pending checks or branch protection, retries only add backoff and delay the same warning path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10148 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `merge_with_followup` bypasses the `_pr_checks_completed` gate that the `merge` action uses.
  WHY: The sync merge path can still fail when checks are pending, so skipping the gate removes the intended fallback filter.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:860 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The standalone `merge_with_followup` path uses synchronous `gh pr merge --squash` on protected-branch/merge-queue repos.
  WHY: Those repos need an auto-merge style wait for checks, so the sync merge can fail immediately and skip the follow-up flow.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:906-913 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The standalone `merge_with_followup` path does not ensure `ai:clarification` before creating the follow-up issue.
  WHY: The orchestrator path adds that label immediately, while the standalone path relies on `clarify.yml` later.
- prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:78-85 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The prompt text implies auto-re-enrollment after a merge without clarifying that it only applies while the PR is still open.
  WHY: That wording can mislead the judge about the already-merged recovery path, even though the code remains conservative.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:860 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The standalone squash-merge path does not pass `--match-head-commit`.
  WHY: A concurrent push can change the head between judging and merging, so the follow-up could be created for the wrong commit.
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:595-1024 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: There is no test covering the merged-PR action guard refusal path.
  WHY: Refactors that break the `PR_ALREADY_MERGED=true` + unsafe action behavior could regress silently.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
